TASKS

Having all your team's tasks in a simple list view will help you get things done faster. Completed tasks are automatically compiled into work reports, so you can get a full overview.


PROJECTS

Collaborate efficiently with your team and get an overview of all the activities, tasks, deadlines, financial aspects of any project in one detailed view.


CUSTOMERS

You can store all valuable information about your customers in one place. Contact details, files, documents, comments and more are just one tap away.


MORE MENU

A number of features can be accessed by tapping on More. These will open a mobile version of your Scoro site. This means you have full access to everything available on the desktop version of Scoro.


Note: This app requires a Scoro account
